protocol.A: First reach of each PDH/PDL/ONH/ONL in RTH, including gap-over. First completed close beyond level=ACCEPT; otherwise REJECT. Direction fixed outward for ACCEPT, inward for REJECT. No later classification. First reach at final bar is counted but has no forward horizon.
protocol.B: Gap up strictly open>PDH; gap down strictly open<PDL. Extreme overnight strictly abs(open-priorRTHclose)/priorATR14>=1.0. At09:30 open and10:00 prior09:59close. Overlapping gap and extreme groups intentionally retained in one family.
protocol.C: At09:30 use18:00-09:30 overnight direction and range; no RTH direction exists yet. At15:00 use09:30open to14:59close and observed RTH range. Direction UP/DOWN (zero omitted); range/ATR SMALL<0.5, MID[0.5,1.2), LARGE>=1.2. First-half-hour and last-hour are included in four fixed horizons, not MOC order-flow proof.
protocol.D: Completed aligned1m or5m block volume>linear empirical95th percentile of exactly20 preceding scheduled sessions at same clock; RVOL=current/previous20mean. All20 observations required. New strict RTH extreme relative to bars before block. Skip first block; both-sides blocks may emit both labels. Direction outward; negative forward mean=exhaustion.
protocol.context: ATR14 mean of14 prior valid complete-session true ranges, point-in-time Panama offsets only when spread known before activation. PDH/PDL/priorclose from immediately previous scheduled complete RTH in current raw basis; no carry through incomplete session. Overnight exact18:00(previous civil date)-09:30 requires all930 minutes; absent levels remain missing. Price outcomes always raw active contract.
protocol.horizons_rule: k=known boundary, endpointbar=k+h-1 or389; no shortening, no zero-length. Clock09:30 anchor=open; other anchors=last completed close. Excursions only bars k..endpoint; eventbar excluded. RTH close proxy=15:59barclose, not settlement/auction.
protocol.inference: Pooled event mean. CR1 sandwich of within-day SUM residuals, t(event_days-1), min20 eventdays. Also daily-score HAC with Bartlett lags1..5, same tdf. Global Holm over32x4x2=256 prespecified log-bp zero-mean tests incl unavailable cells p=1. Points CI and MFE/MAE descriptive, no extra p-tests. Rank by maximum of two Holm p-values, then absolute mean bp, not chosen sign.
protocol.quarters: Every calendar quarter including one-day2024Q4. No quarter p-values, no selection on quarter sign. Quarter counts/means/medians/positive fraction and MFE/MAE all reported.

calibration.model: Independent zero-mean Gaussian LOG innovations,8substeps/minute, independent overnight logjump and volume. No directional predictability; arithmetic-price Jensen drift is not zero. Same selector, horizons and inference. No rerun to significance.

limitations: Exploratory scan on consumed data, not preregistered independent confirmation.
Causal means information timing, not causal identification of institutional agents, stops or MOC orders.
Zero-mean drift tests do not establish incremental prediction beyond same-clock unconditional drift.
No execution assumptions, fees, trades or optimal parameters; favorable/adverse paths are not fillable profits.
Same vendor revised OHLCV, no historical publication-vintage certification. Minute timestamps and OHLC hide intrabar ordering.
Small subgroup counts, overlapping horizons, few quarters and asymptotic uncertainty limit interpretation. Nominal CIs are not simultaneous.
